Dr. Rowe shows sciatica relief exercises to help people over the ages of 55.

They are safe, easy movements that will focus on the main causes of sciatica (including bulging discs and gluteal/piriformis syndrome).

Each exercise works differently. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives the most relief.
